$comment: The one operation set. The panel calls these over HTTP; Claude calls them as MCP tools with the same names and inputs. host=core runs without Rhino; host=rhino needs the plugin. Every mutating op is one undo step, logged with its author.

operations.name: library.list
operations.description: List assemblies and templates in the project library, with total thickness.

operations.name: assembly.get
operations.description: Read one assembly with its layers and computed total thickness.

operations.name: assembly.create
operations.description: Add a new assembly to the project library.

operations.name: assembly.rename
operations.description: Change an assembly's display name.

operations.name: assembly.set_layer
operations.description: Change one layer's material, thickness or flags by index. Fields left out are kept.

operations.name: assembly.insert_layer
operations.description: Insert a layer at an index (exterior/top = 0).

operations.name: assembly.remove_layer
operations.description: Remove the layer at an index. An assembly keeps at least one layer.

operations.name: assembly.move_layer
operations.description: Move a layer from one index to another.

operations.name: assembly.delete
operations.description: Delete an assembly. Refused while any object is assigned to it.

operations.name: template.list
operations.description: List templates with their parameters and the number of variants each can generate.

operations.name: template.preview
operations.description: Generate one variant from a template and parameters without saving it. Reports a matching known assembly if any.

operations.name: template.generate
operations.description: Generate a variant and add it to the library. Ratings are copied only from a matching known assembly; otherwise null (TODO-SOURCE).

operations.name: object.assign
operations.description: Assign an assembly to model objects by object ID. In Rhino this writes object user text and re-graphics the objects.

operations.name: object.clear
operations.description: Remove the assembly assignment from objects.

operations.name: history.undo
operations.description: Undo the last change, whoever made it.

operations.name: history.redo
operations.description: Redo the last undone change.

operations.name: history.log
operations.description: The change log: sequence, operation, author (person or claude), summary.

operations.name: selection.get
operations.description: Object IDs currently selected in Rhino, with their assigned assemblies.

operations.name: walls.from_curves
operations.description: Generate walls from curves with an assembly, location line, base and top level.

operations.name: query.run
operations.description: Run a structured query, e.g. walls where fire_hr >= 1 and level = L2. Returns object IDs.

operations.name: view.color_by
operations.description: Color the viewport by an attribute (assembly, fire_hr, kind). Display only; not an undo step.

operations.name: view.isolate
operations.description: Isolate objects in the viewport. Display only.
